summary: Issue 19 done: fast-forwarded pool/19 onto main (which now holds 18's log pane and /api/log), then made the raw log pane live: it tails new bytes past the last read offset on each SSE snapshot, auto-scrolls only while pinned at the bottom, keeps a clicked older attempt selected when a new attempt starts, and opens long logs tail-first with a load-earlier prepend (via a new bounded end parameter on /api/log) that keeps the view anchored. Pin, scroll, and selection survive full-DOM rebuilds. 212 engine + 77 UI tests, both typechecks, and the build pass.
